home.title: Home
home.description: Welcome to SIMVA! This is the main dashboard where you can access all the features of the platform. Use the menu to navigate through different sections. Whether you're a teacher, student, or researcher, you'll find everything you need to create and manage your simulations here.
home.welcome.teacher.text:
This is the main view of Simva.
You can use the active SIMLETs tab to create a SIMLET, where a set of activities can be set up for an evaluation to be performed.
To get more information visit:
home.welcome.student.text:
This is the main view of Simva.
Use the Play SIMLET tab to access to a created SIMLET where you will perform an evaluation composed by a set of activities.
